name: 单因素 ANOVA 计算器

map.比较多组均值是否存在显著差异。: Tests whether several group means differ significantly.
map.📖 查看「单因素 ANOVA 计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "One-Way ANOVA Calculator User Guide"
map.单因素方差分析把总变异分解为组间（因素引起）与组内（随机误差）两部分：MS_be: One-way analysis of variance splits the total variation into between-group variation (caused by the factor) and within-group variation (random error): MS_between = SS_between/(k−1) and MS_within = SS_within/(N−k), with F as their ratio. A larger F means the between-group differences stand out more against the within-group noise, which tests whether several means are equal.
map.比较 3 组及以上均值。: Compares the means of three or more groups.
map.方差齐性为前提。: Homogeneity of variance is a prerequisite.
map.原假设\"各组均值相等\"。: The null hypothesis is that all group means are equal.
map.显著后做两两比较（Tukey 等）。: Follow a significant result with pairwise comparisons (Tukey and others).
map.组间 SSB、组内 SSW，MSB=SSB/dfB、MSW=SSW/dfW；如: Between-group SSB and within-group SSW give MSB=SSB/dfB and MSW=SSW/dfW; with MSB=30 and MSW=15 the result is F=2.0, df=(2,27). The critical value F(0.05;2,27)≈3.35 is not reached, so it is not significant.
map.F=5.0：超过临界，拒绝\"均值相等\"，至少一组不同。: F=5.0 exceeds the critical value, so equality of means is rejected and at least one group differs.
map.ANOVA 显著后干嘛？: What comes after a significant ANOVA?
map.需事后检验（Tukey HSD、Bonferroni）定位哪两组不同，避免多重比: Post-hoc tests (Tukey HSD, Bonferroni) locate which pair differs, guarding against false positives from multiple comparisons.
map.F 大一定有意义？: Does a large F always matter?
map.F 大且 p 小说明组间差异显著，但效应大小（η²）才反映实际重要性。: A large F with a small p means significant differences between groups, but only the effect size (η²) reflects practical importance.
